area.title: Notification lists: cards, tabs, search, sort and filters
area.scope: A category's notifications list (DR2.1 live animals and germinal products lists; today's animals dashboard): summary cards, tabs, notification cards and the facts and statuses they show, the actions a card offers, search, sort, additional filters, pagination, results count, empty and success states, and the list APIs and read model behind them (animals backend list, INS backend read model). Stops at what each card action does (manage-notifications).

sources.role: the owner's decisions: outranks every other source. The prototype decides look and feel only (content, wording, layout, components, question order); it never decides architecture (sets, journeys, services, URL paths, field names, data-model shape, code structure). Germinal products is a sibling set of live-animals in the animals frontend. Reference lists never wait on MDM integration; address search waits on the address lookup becoming a real feature.
